title: Has anyone ever been to the glass dome covered market outside of the mall?
content: Took me forever to find the right words to generate this picture. It looked a lot like this except the glass looked like the last picture and it was taller. My mall world has a city that looks like London with extremely tall reflective and dark grayish buildings that are parallel and close together. When you are inside a mall world building It’s not easy to get to the exit and find the streets of the city (It took me 25 years to get there! Because my whole life I never knew the street existed! ) It’s a complicated labyrinth of a mall world building and once you find your way out you realize there is a city with more buildings that contain malls and who knows what else. The city of the mall world leads on to different streets and different towns from different dreams of the same mall world. I remember the few dreams with this dome vividly. The street that I could see looking out from inside the glass dome market place was mostly vacant if I did see anyone they were wearing a mask. No cars, no people, nothing happening. There was some kind of understanding that there was a virus outside in the city and that was why we where kept inside. It was dark and cold and cloudy. Outside of the dome and the inside felt room temperature like a mall. What I remember in particular about these dreams is that me and others, as civilians, had to keep this market in a dome to keep us from being outdoors. I remember traveling through buildings and underground tunnels of long walk through malls to get to our residences and other places we had to go to. It felt as if it was all to keep us in doors so that we didn’t have to use the streets and go outside to travel.
